messages:
maya: Rolling Cilium 1.21 in west-2 finished ~02:10 UTC. After the rollout some GPU racks are showing increased pod->pod latency and occasional RDMA retransmits.
andrew: saw the alert on graphs. p50 jumped from 4ms -> ~35ms and p99 to 200ms in short bursts. Any packet-loss numbers?
maya: tcp retransmits on rack-rdma-5, and manual MTU probe between pods sometimes returns "Frag needed":
```
# from pod-a -> pod-b (host-networked ping)
ping -M do -s 1472 10.8.3.12
From 10.8.3.12: Frag needed and DF set (mtu = 1442)
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Completed rollout cilium/1.21 -> west-2 @ 2026-03-19T02:09:30Z
lin: can you paste `ip -d link` for the tunnel interface and `ethtool -i` for the Mellanox NIC on an affected host? kernel version too.
maya: snippets (trimmed):
```
# ip -d link show geneve0
5: geneve0: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST> mtu 1500 qdisc noop state DOWN mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
    link/ether 66:77:88:aa:bb:cc brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff
# ethtool -i ens5f0
driver: mlx5_core
version: 5.15.0-80-generic
firmware-version: 16.25.1040
```
andrew: our RDMA racks usually have host-jumbo MTU ~8972. Looks like tunnel MTU probing is falling back to a small value on some hosts. Any cilium logs?
maya: cilium-agent showed this pattern: 
```
Mar 19 02:12:45 cilium-agent[1987]: level=warn msg="tunnel MTU probe failed" err="invalid argument" src=10.8.2.7 dst=10.8.3.12
Mar 19 02:12:45 cilium-agent[1987]: level=info msg="set tunnel mtu" old=8972 new=1442 reason="probe-failure"
```
lin: upstream has a note about 1.21 and tunnel PMTU probing when NIC offloads are enabled causing probe writes to fail. They mentioned a patch in-flight for 1.21.1. Workarounds: set a conservative tunnelMTU in cilium config, flip off PMTU offloading, or enable host jumbo on hosts that lost it.
tobias: what's the blast radius? Are pods restarting or just throughput/latency regressions?
maya: Mostly transient latency + S3 upload retries for checkpoints. Two experiment jobs restarted after worker-side connection timeouts in the last 4h. Not mass restarts.
andrew: rolling rollback would be painful because of long-running training. Prefer in-place mitigations. The least risky: apply tunnelMTU override via configmap and restart agent on a canary node.
lin: patch flow: fetch cilium-config, change `tunnelMTU: "1442"`, apply, then restart cilium-agent on a single canary GPU host. If stable, roll config cluster-wide. Example:
```
kubectl -n kube-system get configmap cilium-config -o yaml > /tmp/cilium-config.yaml
# edit tunnelMTU: "1442"
kubectl -n kube-system apply -f /tmp/cilium-config.yaml
# on canary host
systemctl restart cilium || kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart daemonset/cilium
```
maya: doing canary now on gpu-node-rack5-03. Will run 20m of synthetic pod->pod latency checks and capture tcpdump + dmesg. ETA ~25m.
ops-bot: incident:open id=INC-20260319-09 severity=medium owner=@lin
lin: plan: 1) collect tcpdump+ip route+ip rule on 3 affected nodes (maya) 2) canary cilium-agent restart after config patch (maya) 3) if canary stable, apply config override for west-2 during low-traffic window (lin) 4) prepare rollback to 1.20 and coordinate with ML team for job impact (andrew)
maya: canary results: after applying tunnelMTU=1442 on node and restarting agent p50 dropped back to ~5ms, p99 improved to ~60ms. Captured tcpdump shows ICMP frag-needed responses before the change and much fewer thereafter.
```
08:12:45.123 IP 10.8.2.7 > 10.8.3.12: ICMP echo request, length 1472
08:12:45.124 IP 10.8.3.12 > 10.8.2.7: ICMP frag needed, mtu 1442
08:12:46.200 TCP 10.8.2.7.443 > 10.8.3.12.52345: Retransmission
```
andrew: good signal. Let's not do cluster-wide restart yet — apply config override and stagger agent restarts during maintenance window. Avoid draining GPU nodes.
lin: opened upstream private bug with logs and packet captures: https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/100123 (private). We'll follow up when 1.21.1 is available.
tobias: please add estimated ML cost impact and number of jobs at risk to the incident. Also capture exact nodes and timestamps for forensics.
maya: added job impact estimate to the ticket. Will continue monitoring the canary for 1h then coordinate a staged apply. tagging @ml-platform to notify of potential upload retries.
